name: naudiobooker
description: Turn an EPUB into an audiobook

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c magenta,yellow,green "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:worker" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: cd api && uv run uvicorn naudiobooker.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: cd api && uv run python -m naudiobooker.worker
scripts.lint:api: cd api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.format:api: cd api && uv run ruff format .
